description: Tampereen keskustan maksulliset pysäköintialueet is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tampere. The data includes paid parking spaces in the public streets and parking areas of the Tampere city centre and Kauppi Kuntokatu area. In addition, the material includes, for example, residential and corporate parking spaces in the city centre area, as well as parking spaces intended for different user groups. Coverage: Tampere. The portal shows the English title as "Paid parking areas in Tampere city centre" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tampere. Its keywords include pysäköintipaikat, pysäköintitalot, liikenne, pysäköintitilat, pysäköintialue. The listing shows 2 download or service links in JSON, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
